objective: Hard-enforce that canonical SourceMargin execution and persistence originate from governed Work Control commands, and surface live execution ownership/process state in the existing Factory UI.
existing_capabilities_reused: Factory Work Control v1 command/claim/receipt ledger

duplication_guard.treatment: Extend existing Work Control persistence boundary and existing Factory UI.

authority_boundary: Workers may produce evidence/results but may not create canonical production state outside a governed Work Control command.
Canonical persistence must fail closed unless the command exists in Work Control, belongs to RUN-004, has an active claim, and matches the receipt stage/run/target.
acceptance_tests: Nonexistent Work Control command is rejected before canonical persistence.
Completed/replayed Work Control command is rejected before canonical persistence.
Stage/run/target mismatch is rejected before canonical persistence.
Factory UI identifies current command, team/agent, process, state, progress and latest stage with near-real-time refresh.
